title: 2 Hours Party Bike Pub Crawl Tour in Glendale California
includes: Dual Karaoke, Bluetooth Speaker, LED Party Lights, Water, Discount Menu, Wristbands
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travel time is included on the total tour duration
You must be 21 and over to drink alcohol on the cart.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Cruise through Glendale’s vibrant streets and take in iconic landmarks, bold architecture, and buzzing local hot spots. Our 2–3 hour rides are perfect for groups of 8–12 guests, combining nonstop fun with breezy sightseeing. Pedaling is not required—our Ebirds are equipped with assist motors, so you can relax, sip, and enjoy the ride while our professional drivers handle all the steering and navigation.

Along the way, we stop at some of Glendale’s favorite bars, breweries, restaurants, and shops. Each of our participating partners also offer free drink promotions and discounts per person, per location. BYOB is welcome, so bring your favorite snacks, beer, wine, cider, or seltzer and turn the journey into a rolling celebration. With Ebird Express, it’s all about good vibes, great views, and an effortless ride!
